findings.summary: The 1x1 kernel shortcut in get_delta_weight checks only size()[2:4] and squeezes dims 3 and 2, which is wrong for 5D Conv3d weights (e.g. (1,1,k) or (1,1,1) kernels), causing wrong shapes or errors in merge/unmerge; it should check all spatial dims.

add_weighted_adapter with SVD combination only handles isinstance(target, Conv2d), so Conv3d 5D delta weights are not flattened, torch.linalg.svd fails, and the reshape back to lora_A/lora_B shapes is skipped.
The Conv3d check's error message wrongly says "Conv2d layer kernel must have 5 dimensions" instead of Conv3d.
The unsupported-module error message still lists only Linear, Conv2d and Conv1D even though Conv3d is now supported.
